notes: Refined existing stories to strengthen deadlock detection, observability, and safe recovery semantics without adding new scope.

change_log.value: Enhanced to include explicit deadlock detection signals (no heartbeat, exceeded TTL, runner inactivity) and guarded reacquisition checks to prevent double-execution.
Extended to include structured logging hooks and metrics emission (acquire success/fail, TTL expiry, forced recovery) alongside API functions.
Clarified integration to include pre-run lock validation, periodic heartbeat renewal, and post-run cleanup to prevent orphaned locks.

BL-0.1.4-003-S1.title: Brain Lock Schema with TTL and Ownership Contract
BL-0.1.4-003-S1.description: Define lock data model including lock_id, owner_id (runner/agent), acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status fields. Establish contract for single-owner enforcement and expiration semantics.

BL-0.1.4-003-S2.title: TTL Enforcement and Deadlock Recovery Logic
BL-0.1.4-003-S2.description: Implement logic to enforce lock expiration, detect stale locks using signals (missing heartbeat, exceeded TTL, inactive runner), and safely reclaim them. Include guarded reacquisition to prevent concurrent execution and validate no active process still owns the lock.

BL-0.1.4-003-S3.title: Internal Lock Management API (Acquire, Renew, Release)
BL-0.1.4-003-S3.description: Expose internal functions for acquiring, renewing (heartbeat), and releasing locks with TTL updates. Ensure ownership validation and rejection of invalid or concurrent acquisition attempts. Emit structured logs and metrics for lock lifecycle events (acquire, renew, expire, recovery).

BL-0.1.4-003-S4.title: Lock TTL and Deadlock Recovery Test Suite
BL-0.1.4-003-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiry, concurrent access, stale lock recovery, and deadlock scenarios to validate correctness under race conditions.

BL-0.1.4-003-S5.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock TTL and Recovery
BL-0.1.4-003-S5.description: Integrate lock acquisition, pre-run validation, periodic heartbeat renewal, and post-run release into brain_runner execution loop to ensure single active execution, automatic recovery from stuck runs, and no orphaned locks after completion or failure.
